answer: Dynamic opportunity-cost bonds lock staking collateral and demand a zero-knowledge verifiable delay, making each forge incur a time-value loss. A subgame-perfect slashing matrix scales penalties with the number of Sybil forks, guaranteeing strictly negative expected attack utility for any deviation. Rational agents therefore converge to a robust Nash equilibrium at the summit of the strategy space, where the timber of locked collateral secures credibility.
